author: Verso2121
quote:
Great presentation, revolutionary graphics but horrendous in all aspects that make a game.Soulless, buggy, boyfriend simulator that tries to force realism only on the aspects that suit the the narrative it wants to tell.
Immersion is great as long as you are not interacting with any of the broken and dumb NPCs that were supposed to have revolutionary AI, yet they are just a small step up from GTA V which came out 13 years ago (In some cases even worse).
Gameplay is shallow and boring as ever. No skill required as the game literally won't let you fail missions, shooting is as basic as it gets, the AI cannot aim to save it's life. But hey, you can repair your house and grill meat, all by pressing R2 in scripted sequences! Isn't that great?
Overall a disgrace to the GTA legacy.
